kit.name: 农历日历
post_install_notes: 侧边栏 → 信息（info）页 → 日历：格子两行（日号 + 农历/节气/节日）+ 右上角 休/班 角标，悬停看详情
节假日数据截止日期与上游版本：./install.sh --check-data
次年放假安排公布后的更新方式见 docs/DATA.md

edits.replace:
component DayButton: RippleButton {
        // BEGIN clavis-lunar-calendar
        // 格子两行：日期数字（上）+ 农历日/节气/节日（下）；右上角 休/班 角标。
        // 数据来自 Common/functions/ChineseCalendar.js（dayInfo(ymd)）；任何异常都降级为原样式。
        // 字号跟随主题：日号取 Typography.bodyMedium（上游基线 14）；9/8 是 38px 格内两行
        // 布局的标定值，按比例派生——打了全局字号补丁的环境会自动跟随。
        id: dayButton

        property string day: ""
        property int todayState: 0
        property bool bold: false
        property string ymd: ""
        readonly property int dayFontSize: Typography.bodyMedium.pixelSize
        readonly property int subFontSize: Math.max(8, Math.round(dayButton.dayFontSize * 0.64))
        readonly property int badgeFontSize: Math.max(7, Math.round(dayButton.dayFontSize * 0.57))
        readonly property var dayInfo: dayButton.ymd.length === 10 ? ChineseCalendar.dayInfo(dayButton.ymd) : null
        readonly property bool inCurrentMonth: dayButton.todayState !== -1
        readonly property bool hasSub: dayButton.inCurrentMonth && dayButton.dayInfo !== null
                                       && dayButton.dayInfo.subText.length > 0
        readonly property string subKind: dayButton.hasSub ? dayButton.dayInfo.subKind : ""
        readonly property string badge: dayButton.inCurrentMonth && dayButton.dayInfo !== null ? dayButton.dayInfo.badge : ""
        readonly property color subColor: dayButton.todayState === 1
            ? Appearance.colors.colOnPrimary
            : dayButton.subKind === "festival"
                ? Appearance.colors.colPrimary
                : dayButton.subKind === "jieqi"
                    ? Appearance.colors.colTertiary
                    : dayButton.subKind === "lunarMonth"
                        ? Appearance.colors.colSecondary
                        : Appearance.colors.colOutline
        readonly property color badgeColor: dayButton.todayState === 1
            ? Appearance.colors.colOnPrimary
            : dayButton.badge === "班"
                ? Appearance.colors.colOutline
                : Appearance.colors.colPrimary

        implicitWidth: 38
        implicitHeight: 38
        padding: 0
        toggled: todayState === 1
        buttonRadius: Appearance.rounding.small
        containerColor: dayButton.todayState === 1 ? Appearance.colors.colPrimary : "transparent"
        stateLayerColor: dayButton.todayState === 1 ? Appearance.colors.colPrimaryHover :
                                                      Appearance.colors.colLayer1Hover
        pressedStateLayerColor: dayButton.todayState === 1 ? Appearance.colors.colPrimaryActive :
                                                             Appearance.colors.colLayer1Active
        rippleColor: dayButton.todayState === 1 ? Appearance.colors.colOnPrimary :
                                                  Appearance.colors.colOnLayer1

        contentItem: Item {
            implicitWidth: 38
            implicitHeight: 38

            Text {
                id: dayText

                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                anchors.verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
                anchors.verticalCenterOffset: dayButton.hasSub ? -6 : 0
                text: dayButton.day
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                verticalAlignment: Text.AlignVCenter
                color: dayButton.todayState === 1 ? Appearance.colors.colOnPrimary : dayButton.todayState === 0
                                                    ? Appearance.colors.colOnLayer1 :
                                                      Appearance.colors.colOutlineVariant
                font.family: Fonts.ui
                font.pixelSize: dayButton.dayFontSize
                font.weight: dayButton.bold ? Font.DemiBold : Font.Normal

                Behavior on color {
                    ColorAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.duration
                        easing.type: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.type
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.bezierCurve
                    }
                }
            }

            Text {
                id: daySubText

                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                anchors.top: dayText.bottom
                anchors.topMargin: -1
                width: parent.width - 2
                visible: dayButton.hasSub
                text: dayButton.hasSub ? dayButton.dayInfo.subText : ""
                elide: Text.ElideRight
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                color: dayButton.subColor
                font.family: Fonts.ui
                font.pixelSize: dayButton.subFontSize
                font.weight: Font.Normal

                Behavior on color {
                    ColorAnimation {
                        duration: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.duration
                        easing.type: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.type
                        easing.bezierCurve: Appearance.animation.expressiveDefaultEffects.bezierCurve
                    }
                }
            }

            Text {
                id: dayBadge

                anchors.right: parent.right
                anchors.top: parent.top
                anchors.rightMargin: 2
                anchors.topMargin: 2
                visible: dayButton.badge.length > 0
                text: dayButton.badge
                horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                color: dayButton.badgeColor
                font.family: Fonts.ui
                font.pixelSize: dayButton.badgeFontSize
                font.weight: Font.Medium
            }
        }

        StyledToolTip {
            text: dayButton.dayInfo !== null ? dayButton.dayInfo.tooltip : ""
            visible: text.length > 0
        }
        // END clavis-lunar-calendar
    }
